title: Derepeat
text: 通过对连续样本求平均值来降低采样率，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Initial condition} 指定初始条件；{Derepeat factor, N} 指定 Derepeat 因子、{Input processing} 指定输入处理控制 Columns as channels、{Rate options} 指定模块处理速率 Allow multirate，按实例取值。

ports.name: In
ports.summary: 输入信号 scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: 输出信号 scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Input processing
params.values: 输入处理控制 Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Rate options
params.values: 模块处理速率 Allow multirate processing (default) | Enforce single-rate processing

params.name: Initial condition
params.values: 初始条件 0 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix
